title: Traditional German Apple Strudel Crumble
description: A delicious German-inspired apple strudel topped with a crunchy crumble and a hint of nutmeg.

ingredients.name: Granny Smith apples, peeled and sliced

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sliced apples, granulated sugar, and ground nutmeg. Mix until the apples are evenly coated.
Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch. Spoon the apple mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten eggs for a golden glaze.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the apple mixture, pressing the edges to seal. Use a knife to cut a few slits in the top of the strudel for steam to escape.
In a separate bowl, combine the crumbly streusel topping and cold unsalted butter. Mix until crumbly and set aside.
Place the strudel on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush the top of the strudel with the beaten eggs for an extra glaze.
Sprinkle the crumbly streusel topping evenly over the top of the strudel.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
